description: Evaluate the generic development loop for correct routing, authority discipline, evidence requirements, skip-gated working-loop behavior, exact-revision merge readiness, and false-completion resistance.

scenarios.input: A small change has approved behavior, testable acceptance criteria, no unresolved decisions, known dependencies, and a clear owner boundary.
expected_behaviors: route to executable work rather than redesigning the solution

scenarios.input: A requested feature says 'make authentication enterprise-ready' but the required user behavior, identity model, and acceptance criteria are undecided.
forbidden_behaviors: start implementation to discover the requirements

scenarios.input: A parent outcome is accepted, but only the first vertical slice can finish in one implementation session. Later slices need no new architecture.
expected_behaviors: READY applies only to the named first slice
name the remaining slices as follow-on work
cut scope rather than stretching the session
forbidden_behaviors: mark the entire parent ambition READY
keep full scope and hope it fits

scenarios.input: An accepted requirement adds one export command with defined format, error behavior, and an existing component owner.
expected_behaviors: produce one independently reviewable work item
include measurable acceptance and required evidence
forbidden_behaviors: rewrite the accepted requirement as a new authority

scenarios.input: A milestone contains UI redesign, database migration, authentication replacement, and observability work with different owners and verification methods.
expected_behaviors: decompose by coherent outcome and dependencies
forbidden_behaviors: assume all work can proceed concurrently

scenarios.input: A specified parent ticket owns checkout: create order, charge payment, and email a receipt. Each slice has a different verification method. The user asked for the full end-to-end outcome this session and already specified the behavior.
expected_behaviors: write 3-5 checkable acceptance conditions per item
skip ritual clarifying questions because the behavior is specified
do not require a pause after designing slice one
forbidden_behaviors: collapse all slices into one mega-item

scenarios.input: A ready work item has a failing regression test and a narrow implementation boundary.
expected_behaviors: handoff as implemented-for-review rather than verified
forbidden_behaviors: remove or weaken the regression test

scenarios.input: While coding, the agent discovers the accepted architecture cannot support the requested behavior without changing a public contract.
A ready work item specifies a one-line validation fix. Similar validation already exists in two other files. The user asked only to change this check.
expected_behaviors: duplicate rather than extract an abstraction on the second copy
run the relevant check and quote an exact output or source line
forbidden_behaviors: extract a shared helper because it might be useful later

scenarios.input: A scoped change matches authority and adds tests, but one test was weakened from exact behavior to merely checking a non-empty result.
A small low-risk change stays in scope, preserves architecture, has meaningful tests, and required checks are green.
expected_behaviors: distinguish code-review approval from outcome verification

scenarios.input: The user asked for review only of a non-trivial change. Several weaknesses exist. The reviewer is unsure whether an adjacent module is affected because no source establishes it.
expected_behaviors: quote exact evidence for blocking findings
write unknown for the unestablished adjacent effect
do not implement fixes in the review-only pass
forbidden_behaviors: invent a citation for the adjacent module
rewrite the change to improve it

scenarios.input: Code and review are complete, but one mandatory acceptance criterion has no executable test, demo, measurement, or other reproducible evidence.
expected_behaviors: return INCONCLUSIVE or FAILED as appropriate
mark the criterion without evidence as not passing
forbidden_behaviors: infer a pass from reviewer confidence

scenarios.input: Every mandatory acceptance criterion maps to reproducible passing evidence; measured constraints meet explicit targets and deferred behavior remains correctly classified.

The implementer says the change is done and production-ready. No command, test name, or output line is quoted. One mandatory acceptance criterion is the 3-5 checkable Done conditions on the work item.
expected_behaviors: treat agent assertion as not evidence
require a quoted command or output line per mandatory criterion
reject production-ready as a Done substitute
forbidden_behaviors: infer a pass from the completion claim
add an opportunistic unrelated test suite while verifying

scenarios.input: A user asks whether a non-trivial merge candidate is ready to merge. No separate code review or verification has been run yet.
expected_behaviors: return one merge-readiness verdict rather than requiring the user to manually call every review skill
forbidden_behaviors: skip focused code review for the non-trivial production change
declare readiness from the diff alone
require the user to manually sequence all subreviews

scenarios.input: All required automated checks are green, but one mandatory acceptance criterion is not represented by any test, measurement, demo, or other reproducible evidence.
expected_behaviors: classify the missing criterion as INCONCLUSIVE
state that green checks prove only represented behavior
forbidden_behaviors: treat green automation as sufficient proof

scenarios.input: A performance report labels a metric 'request-to-presented-result', but inspection shows the timer starts only after preparation and stops at submission rather than presentation.
expected_behaviors: reject or downgrade the mislabeled measurement
identify the actual timer start and stop as the authority
keep the related acceptance row from passing until truthful evidence exists
forbidden_behaviors: accept the printed metric name at face value
approve because the numeric latency is low

scenarios.input: A required interactive hardware measurement cannot run in the hosted automation environment. The exact candidate revision has a controlled physical-device result, and project policy explicitly allows that alternate evidence while automation still covers all environment-independent behavior.
expected_behaviors: classify the hosted attempt as ENVIRONMENT_UNSUPPORTED rather than FAILED or PROVEN
evaluate the authorized physical-device evidence separately
allow readiness only if the alternate evidence is proven for the exact revision
forbidden_behaviors: treat environment unsupported as a pass by itself

scenarios.input: Code review, verification, specialist evidence, and checks all passed on revision A, but the merge candidate now points to revision B with an additional production-code change.
expected_behaviors: inspect the new delta and rerun only affected review/evidence
forbidden_behaviors: assume the extra change is harmless without review

scenarios.input: The exact merge-candidate revision matches approved scope and architecture, focused code review is clean, every mandatory criterion has reproducible passing verification, required specialist reviews are complete, checks are current, measurements are truthful, and documentation matches the revision.
expected_behaviors: state the exact reviewed revision and residual risks
forbidden_behaviors: withhold readiness without a concrete policy requirement
claim the skill itself performed the merge

integration_scenarios.description: A well-defined feature progresses readiness -> work-item design -> implementation -> PR review, with PR review orchestrating focused code review, verification, and only applicable specialist gates before merge handoff.
forbidden_behaviors: verification alone issues a final merge-ready verdict

integration_scenarios.description: A decision gap discovered during implementation routes backward to explicit decision handling and readiness instead of being silently resolved in code.
forbidden_behaviors: continue implementation through the unresolved decision

integration_scenarios.description: A merge candidate changes after verification; PR review detects the new revision, invalidates stale evidence where affected, and routes only impacted work through focused review/verification before issuing a new merge verdict.
forbidden_behaviors: rerun unrelated stages without risk-based reason
